status: RESEARCH BUILD — selected as best of 3 models by field-photo accuracy; trained on unlicensed gitergo data, so NOT cleared for commercial release; not field-validated on farmer photos
architecture: MobileNetV2 (ImageNet-pretrained) -> GlobalAveragePooling2D -> Dense(128, relu) -> Dropout(0.3) -> Dense(7, softmax)
backbone: MobileNetV2 (ImageNet weights from a GitHub-hosted mirror)
taxonomy_scope_note: V2-alpha covers Corn and Potato only (7 of the originally frozen 18 classes). Rice/Wheat/Sugarcane are DEFERRED due to a real network-access blocker (Mendeley/Zenodo/Kaggle unreachable this session), not silently dropped -- see dataset_manifest.json:datasets_deferred.

training_configuration.architecture: MobileNetV2 (ImageNet-pretrained) -> GlobalAveragePooling2D -> Dense(128, relu) -> Dropout(0.3) -> Dense(7, softmax)
training_configuration.augmentation: random horizontal flip, random brightness (+-0.15), random contrast (0.85-1.15), random crop after pad -- train split only, applied after split assignment

validation_metrics_at_best_checkpoint.note: Stage 2 best val_loss (0.20079) did not beat Stage 1 best (0.17723) even though val_accuracy improved -- see docs/ml_v2_training_report.md for the honest discussion of this.

ood_metrics.scope_note: V1's original SAGE real-world, 2,265-image off-taxonomy, and Sugarcane-OOD test sets could NOT be replicated for V2 -- the delivered AgriMind-ML-Evaluation.zip contains only V1's prediction CSVs for those tests, not the underlying source images (verified this session: only 07_Manual_Test/test_corn_rust.jpg is an actual image file anywhere in that archive). This OOD evaluation instead uses real, license-verified PlantVillage images from four crops/diseases outside V2-alpha's own taxonomy (Tomato Bacterial Spot, Tomato Late Blight, Apple Black Rot, Grape Black Rot) as a genuine real-image OOD set, plus 100 synthetic non-plant images. This is NOT the same test V1 was scored against, so V1-vs-V2 OOD numbers are NOT directly comparable -- see docs/ml_v2_ood_report.md for the full honest comparison caveat.
ood_metrics.recommended_rule: combined_or (confidence OR embedding-distance) -- see docs/ml_v2_ood_report.md for why neither method alone, nor this combined rule, is considered production-adequate

known_limitations: Covers only Corn and Potato (7 classes) -- Rice, Wheat, Sugarcane not yet trained

Real-world (PlantDoc) test accuracy (63.5%) is far below lab-image (PlantVillage) test accuracy (95.1%) on the same held-out test split -- the lab-to-field generalization gap V1 demonstrated is NOT resolved in V2-alpha
Corn Gray Leaf Spot vs Northern Leaf Blight confusion persists (same pair V1 struggled with)

OOD rejection substantially improved over V1 for synthetic non-plant input via the embedding-distance method (89% rejection vs V1s demonstrated near-total failure) but real off-taxonomy PLANT disease images are still missed roughly 73% of the time by the combined rule -- OOD is not solved
V1s original SAGE/2,265-image/Sugarcane-OOD test sets could not be re-run against V2 because only V1s prediction CSVs, not the source images, were available this session
